cause: Exact text or weak AST mapping changes wrong code
mitigation: AST ownership, base hashes, temp worktree, semantic diff, backup, verification

cause: Control-plane assets/routes/metadata enter dist or hosting
mitigation: Loopback-only design and mandatory leakage scan

cause: Secrets enter chat, browser, logs, source, backup, or artifact
mitigation: Never-paste policy, secret stores, redaction, scans, rotation

cause: Operation runs against production or wrong account
mitigation: Target identity, emulator default, plan-bound approval, preflight

cause: Stale editor overwrites newer document/source
mitigation: Expected revisions, object conflicts, rebase report

cause: Journal cannot reproduce document/release
mitigation: Pure handlers, versioned migrations, hashes, replay tests

cause: Extension exfiltrates or takes editor authority
mitigation: Sandbox, manifest, capabilities, integrity, dependency policy

cause: Imported source/content instructs agent to exceed scope
mitigation: Treat imported text as data; bounded MCP commands; human approval

cause: Editor preview differs from browser/output
mitigation: Standards-based resolver and browser conformance corpus

cause: Prop/slot/variant change orphans instances
mitigation: Versioning, impact report, migration functions, rollback

cause: Field/schema change loses data or breaks bindings
mitigation: Impact/backfill/emulator/approval/integrity reports

cause: Direct API call bypasses hidden control
mitigation: Command capability enforcement and role matrix tests

cause: Source/import path escapes repo
mitigation: Canonical realpath, symlink policy, hostile fixtures

cause: Malicious/huge project freezes LAN
mitigation: Limits, workers, timeout, cancellation, inventory-only

cause: Current useful LAN flows break
mitigation: Characterization tests, strangler adapters, feature flags

cause: Comments/history/bindings/source maps drift
mitigation: Stable fingerprints and golden import fixtures

cause: Large document makes tree/inspector unusable
mitigation: Normalized graph, indexes, virtualization, budgets

cause: Operators run removed/unsafe commands
mitigation: Generated command/path/version validation

cause: Unsupported code patterns get damaged
mitigation: Capability classification and read-only/needs-review states

cause: Logs retain source, PII, tokens, form values
mitigation: Event allowlist, redaction, retention, integrity checks

cause: Approved plan differs from applied plan
mitigation: Approval bound to hash/revision/target/expiry

cause: Locales generate duplicate or wrong routes
mitigation: Locale route graph and publish validation

cause: Animation hides content or ignores reduced motion
mitigation: Reduced-motion/initial-state policy and tests

cause: Tracking ignores consent or exposes internal IDs
mitigation: Runtime consent API and publish-safe identifier mapping

cause: Webhook/command charges or orders twice
mitigation: Idempotency, provider event ledger, test mode

cause: Product appears to copy Webflow branding/interface
mitigation: Clean-room naming, original visual system, legal/trademark review

cause: Hard-coded Webflow-like quotas/prices become inaccurate
mitigation: Capability/entitlement model and configurable quotas
